name: Innsbruck Christmas Market
beschreibung: The historic center of Innsbruck transforms into a dazzling light display. The Christkindlmarkt around the Golden Roof is one of the most beautiful in Austria. Artisan crafts, mulled wine, roasted Maroni, and traditional Tyrolean delicacies create a heartfelt pre-Christmas atmosphere.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Innsbruck Christmas Market in the old town – magical Christmas cheer right in front of the Golden Roof.
